result.summary: Review fixes applied locally as commit 5c0a465 on xt/xtrm-404 (NOT yet pushed): (1) detail-cache timeout root-caused — added resolveGithubCredential latency could push fetch issuance past the 20 ms section budget, and the test's abortingNever mock (unlike real fetch) never settles on an already-aborted signal -> infinite hang; mock fixed to reject on aborted signal (faithful to fetch); base passes 6/6, branch was 4/5 before fix, 15/15 solo + 5/5 file after. (2) resolveGithubCredential now caches only the gh-subprocess result (env read fresh, user path live so refresh-before-expiry intact); service invalidates on sign-in/sign-out/refresh. (3) keychain probe measured: 5 ms fail-fast, cached per process; file store in use on this host. Gates: typecheck OK; apps/console 122 files / 682 pass + 1 skip; packages/core github tests 79/79; lint OK; build OK. Core observability-adapter timing flakes only (13 this run; proven pre-existing on stashed base). BLOCKED on push: pre-push beads-sync hook 'bd dolt pull' fails 'cannot merge with uncommitted changes' (main-checkout Dolt workspace dirty, operator state, untouched); no --no-verify per coordinator instruction — awaiting operator approval to push 5c0a465 to PR #82.
